methods_detail.candidate_workaround: Insert the repository root before test discovery and require the exact expected test count.
methods_detail.failure_signature: A script launched from the scripts directory asks unittest to import repository-root test modules before adding the repository root to sys.path.
methods_detail.recurrence_guard: Canonical validators must establish import roots before loading any repository test module.
methods_detail.rollback: Retain the failed canonical receipt at zero credit and use one additive correction commit.
methods_detail.scope_boundary: Validation-loader recovery only; no scientific, production, independent-reproduction, or authority credit.
methods_detail.title: Establish repository import roots before unittest discovery

methods_detail.candidate_workaround: Use a simple quoted path read or a single-quoted pattern with no transport ambiguity.
methods_detail.failure_signature: A PowerShell diagnostic embeds a double quote inside an already double-quoted regular expression.
methods_detail.recurrence_guard: Preflight shell quoting before diagnostic execution and prefer exact line-range reads.
methods_detail.rollback: Retain the read-only failure at zero credit; no repository rollback is required.
methods_detail.scope_boundary: Read-only diagnostic recovery only; no scientific, production, independent-reproduction, or authority credit.
methods_detail.title: Use transport-safe quoted diagnostic patterns

methods_detail.candidate_workaround: Read raw porcelain lines without global trimming, then remove exactly the two status columns and separator.
methods_detail.failure_signature: A helper globally strips Git porcelain output and removes the leading status-space from the first line.
methods_detail.recurrence_guard: Never apply strip to positional Git porcelain output before parsing.
methods_detail.rollback: Retain the fail-closed refusal at zero credit; no generated artifact was accepted.
methods_detail.scope_boundary: Owner-local status parsing recovery only; no scientific, production, independent-reproduction, or authority credit.
methods_detail.title: Preserve porcelain status columns before path parsing

methods_detail.candidate_workaround: Assert each immutable lifecycle ledger against its own frozen count and update only the additive correction assertion.
methods_detail.failure_signature: A test applies the correction Method Flow count to the immutable closeout ledger and the stale correction count to the current correction ledger.
methods_detail.recurrence_guard: Label every derived count with its exact lifecycle artifact before changing tests.
methods_detail.rollback: Retain the failed correction-stage test at zero credit and rebuild only additive correction artifacts.
methods_detail.scope_boundary: Lifecycle assertion recovery only; no scientific, production, independent-reproduction, or authority credit.
methods_detail.title: Keep lifecycle-ledger assertions phase specific

witnesses.observed: Three test-module import errors at the first canonical head.
The corrected loader established the repository root before discovering all phase tests.
The misquoted diagnostic failed before file inspection.
The exact line-range read returned the intended validator sections without parsing ambiguity.
The first modified scripts path lost its initial letter and triggered an out-of-scope refusal.
The untrimmed parser preserved every owner path and admitted only the exact correction scope.
One of sixty-nine correction-stage tests failed because closeout and correction counts were reversed.
The recovered test preserved the immutable closeout count and verified the expanded correction count separately.
